title: BirthdayPlugin
description: Celebrate server player's birthdays / server birthday with fun and configurable features.
body:
# BirthdayPlugin 
Celebrate server players' birthdays/server birthday with fun and configurable features.

## Features

* Give a cake to a player on their birthday or after a set cooldown.
* Broadcast messages with MiniMessage and legacy color support.
* Admin commands: `/birthday reload`, `/birthday reset <player>`, `/birthday toggle`.
* Configurable cooldown and enable/disable settings.
* Optional broadcast messages that can be turned off.
* SQLite database stores last claim dates.
* Fully configurable messages with MiniMessage gradients.

## Commands

* `/birthday` — claim your birthday cake.
* `/birthday reload` — reload the plugin config.
* `/birthday reset <player>` — reset a player's claim date.
* `/birthday toggle` — enable or disable cake giving.

## Configuration

* `cooldown_seconds` — number of seconds to wait before the next claim.
* `enabled` — `true` or `false` to enable or disable cake giving.
* `broadcast_enabled` — `true` or `false` to enable or disable broadcast messages.
* All messages are fully configurable.

Any bugs can be sent to me on Telegram
